overview: KLIPPER AI PRO turns a YouTube link into ready-to-post short-video plans: it pulls the real transcript, uses AI to pick the best moments with exact timestamps, and writes titles, captions and hashtags for each clip.
features: Paste a YouTube link and choose max clip duration, aspect ratio and subtitles
Fetch the video's real transcript and metadata
AI selects the best moments with exact start and end timestamps
AI writes an attractive title, caption and hashtags for each clip
Live progress bar with named processing stages
Saved plan library with unique names, copy and download
